title: Hosting on a US cloud
prompt: Can I host my SA customers' data on AWS us-east-1? Do I need anything special?
must: Explains this is a cross-border transfer under s72 and lists the grounds
Recommends a binding agreement (DPA) with POPIA-equivalent terms as the usual basis
Notes the Regulator has not published an adequacy list
Mentions disclosing the transfer in the privacy notice (s18(1)(g))
Mentions s57(1)(d) prior authorisation for special or children's information to a country without adequate protection
must_not: Says the US is adequate under POPIA
